title: Yichuan Liu, MIT 15.401 Finance Theory I — Recitation 2: Fixed-Income Securities (slides dated 2010, hosted with Fall 2008 course)
use: Scoped companion for spot/forward relations, coupon-bond yield versus date-specific discounting, dated cash-flow replication, and Macaulay/modified-duration and dollar-exposure terminology. All chapter cases, proofs, numerical values and exercises are original.
verification: Actual official 29-page PDF body inspected, especially PDF pages 2–4, 15–18 and 20; author/date labels read as Yichuan Liu/2010. Extraction around formulas is imperfect; chapter formulas are independently derived. The apparent negative convexity sign at PDF page 19 and any claim of perfect general immunization are not adopted. No source example or historical market observation is reused.

title: F. M. Redington — Review of the Principles of Life-Office Valuations (1952), original paper in Society of Actuaries reprint
use: Historical common-rate immunization framework: equal initial present value, zero first surplus derivative and positive second derivative provide a local result; nonuniform rates, evolving cash flows and practical matching limitations require separate analysis. The chapter supplies its own finite proof and original cash-flow examples.
verification: Actual original paper body in the official SOA-hosted reprint inspected, especially sections 3–4 and their local Taylor argument and practical qualifications. No insurance example, current regulatory rule, historical statistic or universal perfect-immunization claim is imported.

title: Robert W. Kopprasch and Steven V. Mann — Yield Curve Strategies, summary in CFA Institute 2017 CFA Program Changes
use: Narrow terminology companion distinguishing maturity-segment key-rate exposure from a single modified/effective duration, and dollar sensitivity from normalized sensitivity. The continuous-zero interpolation basis, gradient, Hessian, proofs and original twist cases are derived in the chapter.
verification: Actual official 93-page PDF body inspected at the Yield Curve Strategies summary, printed pages 49–51 (PDF pages 55–57), including money duration, PVBP and key-rate segment-risk statements. No broad barbell-performance claim, future yield forecast, current market rule or claim that a finite-difference estimate is exact for arbitrary large changes is adopted.
